# `get_compass_state`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Return the number of compass samples collected so far in the current calibration run.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (strict; the only writes are shared diagnostic logging). Behaviourally a getter. |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xb92c0 (64-bit build); helper getCompassState |

No parameters are read. The handler locks the compass mutex, copies the sample count and returns it as result.number. Despite the name it is not a state enumeration. The handler has a nominal helper-failure branch but the helper always returns success, so no handler-specific error is established. Calibration progress and outcome are sent as CompassCalibration events; see start_compass_calibration.

Side effects: None beyond shared diagnostic logging. Full command-socket calls also incur the shared diagnostic (logging) writes; this is why the strict grade is MUTATOR even for the read-only calls.

No handler-specific error is reachable in the inspected code.

## Example

Request, request:

```json
{"id":23,"method":"get_compass_state"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_compass_state","result":{"number":42},"code":0,"id":23}
```
